{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索两册仓单记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"宁简凭初三有效仓单从西仓发粮，转仓交接完成；宋禾依据旧仓单仍到东仓排队。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-F9XP","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A66dd2c99-0329-4694-9835-2bfa9bc86988:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:66dd2c99-0329-4694-9835-2bfa9bc86988"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["宁简凭初三有效仓单从西仓发粮，转仓交接完成；宋禾依据旧仓单仍到东仓排队。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"街坊木匠给长凳换腿，木材不来自粮仓，也不使用仓单。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-F9XP","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A6cf5b214-19c1-4ee5-bcbd-6acfe930ef87:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:6cf5b214-19c1-4ee5-bcbd-6acfe930ef87"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["街坊木匠给长凳换腿，木材不来自粮仓，也不使用仓单。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"初一十袋粮在东仓，初二全部转到西仓；旧仓单对初一有效，新仓单记录初二后的状态。仓储规约写明：提粮必须到当日有效仓单指定的仓库。账桌上铺着一块粗麻布。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-F9XP","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Aa6a57bf2-61f8-4aed-8a93-db0e1533fe82:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:a6a57bf2-61f8-4aed-8a93-db0e1533fe82"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["初一十袋粮在东仓，初二全部转到西仓；旧仓单对初一有效，新仓单记录初二后的状态。仓储规约写明：提粮必须到当日有效仓单指定的仓库。账桌上铺着一块粗麻布。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"宋禾只见初一旧仓单，相信初三粮仍在东仓；宁简登记过转仓，知道初三粮在西仓。宁简依据初二转仓记录注销旧仓单的当前效力，同时保留初一历史。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-F9XP","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Afcc1c116-a457-499b-8995-804c8d585009:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:fcc1c116-a457-499b-8995-804c8d585009"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["宋禾只见初一旧仓单，相信初三粮仍在东仓；宁简登记过转仓，知道初三粮在西仓。宁简依据初二转仓记录注销旧仓单的当前效力，同时保留初一历史。"]}]}
